summary: Verified Google Maps-only migration (OSM fallback fully removed). Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass, including a source-code check confirming no nominatim/osm/haversine/openstreetmap references in server.py. /api/maps/autocomplete returns HTTP 403 with user-friendly detail 'Google Maps API key is not authorized for this service. Please enable the API on your key's restriction list in Google Cloud Console.' /api/maps/distance-km returns HTTP 400 with 'Google Maps API key is invalid or unauthorized.' — both messages plain-English, not raw Google JSON. /api/vehicles returns correct rates (10/20/30). /api/bookings recalculates fare server-side: tata_ace 5.0 km → ₹100.00 ✓, two_wheeler 3.5 km → ₹35.00 ✓, bada_dost 2.0 km → ₹60.00 ✓. Invalid vehicle_type rejected (400). List bookings excludes _id. Frontend: on typing pickup address, [data-testid=autocomplete-error] renders the friendly message and no suggestions dropdown appears (confirming no silent OSM fallback). BOOK NOW button is disabled (aria-disabled=true) because distanceKm is null. Fare summary shows DISTANCE '-- KM', ETA '--' (testID duration-value present), TOTAL '₹--'. Vehicle switching works. GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY read cleanly from backend/.env (backend healthy on /api/).

react_native_issues.issue: TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated in React Native — non-blocking, previously noted. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:563

action_items: None required for this iteration. When user unlocks the Google Maps API key (enables Places API New + Distance Matrix + removes API restrictions), the same code will serve real autocomplete + distance results with provider='google' — tests are already tolerant (they accept a 200 with provider=google as a pass, or a 4xx with friendly detail).
Optional (previously noted): replace TouchableWithoutFeedback with Pressable in BookingFormModal.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py fully purged of OSM/Nominatim/Haversine — grep confirms zero matches.
_friendly_google_error() maps 403 / PERMISSION_DENIED / API_KEY_SERVICE_BLOCKED / REQUEST_DENIED / OVER_QUERY_LIMIT / INVALID_REQUEST / ZERO_RESULTS to plain-English messages. Good coverage.
Autocomplete endpoint correctly uses Places API (New) POST https://places.googleapis.com/v1/places:autocomplete with X-Goog-Api-Key + X-Goog-FieldMask headers.
distance-km handles both raw placeIds and free-form addresses via the _fmt() helper, correctly prefixing bare placeIds with 'place_id:'.
Server-side fare recalculation from VEHICLE_RATES ignores client-supplied fare — good security practice.
GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY loaded via os.environ[...] at import time — will fail fast if missing (correct behavior).
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_ bookings via API (TEST_User tata_ace, TEST_Two two_wheeler, TEST_Bd bada_dost) — persisted in bookings collection for regression.
